note: WebVoyager-style public web tasks, account-safe: no sign-in, sign-up, purchase or non-search form. 'open' sites have little bot protection; 'protected' sites are known to run bot defences. Checks: exact | oneOf | regex | number {min,max} | price | text {minLength}. 'domain' must appear in the pages the agent visited.
